test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of a sentence/paragraph are given below. While the first and the last parts (A and F) are in the correct order, the parts in between are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence/paragraph.**

A. I love

B. so that

C. every morning

D. for a walk

E. to go

F. I can keep myself fit and healthy.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **E, D, C, B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins by stating the subject and verb: **"I love to go". **
 
• The next part of the sentence tells us where the speaker likes to go:** "for a walk".**
 
• The following part of the sentence indicates the frequency of this activity: **"every morning".**
 
• The next part of the sentence provides the reason for doing this: **"so that".**
 
• Finally, the last part of the sentence concludes with the purpose of the activity:** "I can keep myself fit and healthy".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4: E, D, C, B.**

 

The correct order of the parts to form a meaningful sentence is** A, E, D, C, B, F.**

**A. **I love

**E. **to go

**D. **for a walk

**C. **every morning

**B. **so that

**F.** I can keep myself fit and healthy.
